name: @ai-km/features
description: ADR 0008 — 分階段 Gherkin 規格與 cucumber 步驟定義。每個能力一個資料夾,每個 phase 一份 .feature;docs/integration/ 的整合點驗收也由這裡的 runner 執行。

scripts.accept:phase1: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js --tags '@phase-1 and not @manual and not @e2e'
scripts.accept:integration: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js ../docs/integration --tags '(@i1) and not @manual and not @e2e'
scripts.accept:integration:next: NODE_OPTIONS=--import=tsx cucumber-js ../docs/integration --tags '(@i2) and not @manual and not @e2e'
scripts.test: tsx scripts/check-gherkin-dup.ts && tsx scripts/check-step-dup.ts && tsx scripts/check-doc-links.ts
